pg_bignumber_desc: Displays a prominent key statistic with an animated count-up on entry.
pg_bignumber_props: Props: value (number), label (string), prefix (optional), suffix (optional), decimals (optional). Uses Intl.NumberFormat via fmt().
pg_areatrend_desc: Recharts area trend chart with dynamic gradient and highlighted ring marker on the latest point.
pg_areatrend_props: Props: data ({ year: number, value: number }[]), xKey, yKey, unit. Colors inherited from CSS custom properties.
pg_horizontalbar_desc: Horizontal bar chart with rank-based gradient, value + percent label at bar end, and hover dimming.
pg_horizontalbar_props: Props: data ({ label: { id, en }, value: number }[]), showPercent, valueUnit. Responsive on small screens.
pg_donut_desc: Hand-built SVG donut with HTML callout cards connected to slice angles, center caption, and hover highlights.
pg_donut_props: Props: data ({ id: string, label: { id, en }, value: number, dx?: number, dy?: number }[]), centerCaption (string).
pg_sankey_desc: Proportional budget allocation Sankey flow diagram with pure SVG ribbons, pin needles, and source/destination stacks.
pg_gauge_desc: Hand-built SVG semicircle gauge with animated sweep, large center percentage, and tick marks 0-80.
pg_gauge_props: Props: value (number 0-100), label (string), min (optional), max (optional). Respects prefers-reduced-motion.
pg_radar_desc: 6-axis Recharts radar chart with filled achieved area and dashed benchmark reference line.
pg_radar_props: Props: data ({ subject: { id, en }, score: number, fullMark: number }[]), avgScore (number).
pg_sdgbars_desc: 17 SDG columns in two rows (9 + 8), comparing 2024 vs 2025 with percent change badges.
pg_sdgbars_props: Props: data ({ goal: number, y2024: number, y2025: number }[]), filter options (all, 2024, 2025).
